info.title: DBW Orders
info.description:
Use DBW (Delivery by WB Courier) Orders methods to:
  - get [assembly orders](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Assembly-Orders) information, manage statuses, and cancel assembly orders
  - get, add, edit, and delete [metadata](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Metadata) for assembly orders

tags.name: DBW Assembly Orders
tags.description:
To access the methods, use a token for the Marketplace category
How to work with DBW assembly orders: 1. [Get a new assembly order](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1new/get). 2. [Transfer it for assembly](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1confirm/patch). 3. After the assembly order is moved to assembly, [information about the courier](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1courier/post) (phone, vehicle number) becomes available. To allow the courier to contact you, [link](./work-with-products#tag/Seller-Warehouses/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1warehouses~1%7BwarehouseId%7D~1contacts/put) your contacts to the warehouse. You can also [get](./work-with-products#tag/Seller-Warehouses/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1warehouses~1%7BwarehouseId%7D~1contacts/get) the current list of your contacts. 4. [Get](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1stickers/post), print, and attach the stickers. 5. [Transfer to delivery](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1assemble/patch). 6. Waiting for the courier. 7. The courier picks up the order and delivers it to the buyer. 8. The buyer accepts or declines the order. 9. If the buyer accepts the order, the courier changes the assembly order status to `receive`. If the buyer declines, it is changed to `reject`.

Описание метода
Returns the statuses of orders based on the provided list of assembly order IDs `supplierStatus` is a status of an order. The trigger for its change is the action of the seller himself.
Possible values for this field are: | Status | Description | How to move an order to this status | | ------- | --------- | --------------------------------------| | `new` | **New order** | | | `confirm` | **Order on assembly** | [Transfer to assembly](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1confirm/patch) | `complete` | **Order on delivery**
| [Transfer to delivery](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1assemble/patch) | `receive` | **Received by the buyer**
| Changed by the courier | `reject` | **Declined upon receipt**
| Changed by the courier | `cancel` | **Canceled by the seller** | [Cancel the order](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1cancel/patch) | `cancel_missed_call` | **Cancellation due to unreachable buyer** | The status changes automatically | `wbStatus` is a status of an order on the Wildberries side.
Possible values for this field are: - `waiting` — order in work - `sold` — the buyer got the order - `canceled` — order canceled - `canceled_by_client` — the buyer canceled the order - `declined_by_client` — the buyer canceled the order in the first hour
Cancellation is available to the buyer in the first hour from the moment of order, if the order is not transferred to confirm status. - `defect` — order canceled due to a defect - `canceled_by_missed_call` — cancellation due to unreachable buyer - `postponed_delivery` — courier delivery is postponed
Request limit per one seller's account for DBW methods:

  • for getting and deleting metadata
  • assembly orders
| Period | Limit | Interval | Burst | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 min | 300 requests | 200 ms | 20 requests | One request with a response code of 409 is counted as 10 requests

post.description:
Описание метода
Returns a list of stickers for the [assembly orders](/openapi/orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1new/get) in the [statuses](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1status/post): - `confirm` — on assembly - `complete` — on delivery You can get a maximum of 100 stickers per request.
Available sticker formats: - SVG - ZPLV (vertical) - ZPLH (horizontal) - PNG Available dimensions: - 580x400 px, with `width=58&height=40` in request - 400x300 px, with `width=40&height=30` in request

put.summary: Add Labeling Code Chestny ZNAK to the Order{{ /api/v3/dbw/orders/{orderId}/meta/sgtin }}
put.description:
Описание метода
This method allows you to assign a Data Matrix code (Chestny ZNAK marking) to an order.
The assignment of a Data Matrix code to an order is only possible if this field is returned in the response of the [Get order metadata](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Metadata/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1meta/get) method and the order is in the `confirm` status.

You can get the uploaded labeling code [Chestny ZNAK](https://chestnyznak.ru/en) using the [Get order metadata](./orders-dbw#tag/DBW-Metadata/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbw~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1meta/get) method.
Request limit per one seller's account for all methods for adding DBW metadata: | Period | Limit | Interval | Burst | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 min | 1000 requests | 60 ms | 20 requests | One request with a response code of 409 is counted as 10 requests

sgtins.description: List of labeling codes Chestny ZNAK

items.description: Labeling code [Chestny ZNAK](https://chestnyznak.ru/en) on the package. From 16 to 135 characters

replacementPhone.description:
Replacement phone number to contact the buyer.
An empty value `""` means that the number is not assigned yet

phone.description:
Buyer contact phone number:
  - if the extension code is not specified in the `phoneCode` field, you can call the buyer using the specified number. Additional phone numbers that do not need extension codes are specified in the `additionalPhones` field
  - if the extension code is specified in the `phoneCode` field, use it to reach the buyer via the specified number and extension code

fullName.description: Buyer full name, used for documents

additionalPhones.description:
Additional phone numbers to contact the buyer.
Use it to call the buyer, if the main number from `phone` is unavailable.
An empty value means that the number is not specified

additionalPhoneCodes.description:
Additional extension codes.
Use it if you could not reach the buyer using the extension code from `phoneCode`.
An empty value means that the codes are not assigned yet

phoneCode.description:
Extension phone code.
Use it to reach the buyer via the number from `phone`.
If the code is not specified, you can call the buyer without codes

pTimeFrom.description: Date and time from which the courier will arrive

pTimeTo.description: Date and time by which the courier will arrive

mustBeAssigned.description:
If the the courier should be assigned by the current moment:
 - `false` — no
 - `true` — yes

 If `"mustBeAssigned": true` and `"contacts": null`, then you need to request the contacts from [support](https://seller.wildberries.ru/service-desk-v2)

updatedAt.description:
Date and time of the courier information update.
If `null`, the information has not been updated

orders.description: Assembly orders metadata and validation statuses

decision.description:
State:
- `imei`
  - `pending` — Metadata for inspection
  - `optional` — Metadata is not required
  - `filled` — Validation passed
  - `deadlineExceeded` — Validation passed
  - `imeiMaySell` — The product is approved for sale. Validation passed
  - `imeiSoldB2B` — The product was sold to a B2B buyer and allowed to be sold again. Validation passed
  - `required` — Required metadata is not filled. Validation failed
  - `imeiInvalidFormat` — Invalid format. Validation failed
  - `imeiAlreadySold` — The item with this IMEI has already been sold. Validation failed
- `uin`
  - `filled` — Validation passed
  - `optional` — Metadata is not required
- `sgtin`
  - `pending` — Metadata for inspection
  - `optional` — Metadata is not required
  - `filled` — Validation passed
  - `deadlineExceeded` — Validation passed
  - `sgtinIntroduced` — The product is approved for sale. Validation passed
  - `sgtinSoldB2B` — The product was sold to a B2B buyer and allowed to be sold again. Validation passed
  - `required` — Required metadata is not filled. Validation failed
  - `sgtinInvalidFormat` — Invalid format. Validation failed
  - `sgtinNotFound` — Metadata not found in [Chestny ZNAK](https://chestnyznak.ru/en/). Validation failed
  - `sgtinEmitted` —  Metadata has been issued. Validation failed
  - `sgtinApplied` — Putting into circulation not completed. Validation failed
  - `sgtinWrittenOff` — Written off. Validation failed
  - `sgtinRetired` — Retired. Validation failed
  - `sgtinWithdrawn` — Withdrawn. Validation failed
  - `sgtinDisaggregation` — Disaggregation. Validation failed
  - `sgtinDisaggregated` — Disaggregated. Validation failed
  - `sgtinAppliedNotPaid` — Not paid. Validation failed
- `gtin`
  - `optional` — Metadata is not required
  - `filled` — Validation passed
- `customsDeclaration`
  - `optional` — Metadata is not required
  - `filled` — Validation passed
